territories.name: Proofs
territories.blurb: Formal artifacts and the honesty of what they claim. Red here means a stated guarantee is not the guarantee that holds.

regions.name: Closure claims
regions.summary: 1 file(s) assert completeness while carrying a marker.

findings.title: A file claims closure it does not have
evidence: claim (line 90): - The ECC proof chain is CLOSED: no axiom, no sorry, non-vacuous.
findings.why: `sorry` makes Lean ACCEPT the file, so a green build is evidence of compilation, not of closure. Nothing else in the toolchain compares the prose claim against the tactic block.
findings.clears: Discharge the marker, or retract the claim. Either is honest; the contradiction is not.

findings.title: Incompleteness marker that no axiom audit examines
evidence: not in any `#print axioms` audit step
findings.why: lean-proof.yml audits a hand-maintained list. A file on neither list is invisible — not type-checked, not audited, not gated — and nothing notices the absence.
findings.clears: Add the file to the audit list. Note this may legitimately turn the Lean job red, which is a human call.
